Home.title: Every rescue animal deserves the right home
Home.lead: Homeward connects rescue organisations with people looking to adopt, with clear information about which animals suit which homes.
Home.adopterBody: Tell us about your home and household, privately. We show you at a glance which animals are a strong match, which might work, and why.
Home.orgBody: Get animals online quickly with structured details, photos and adoption criteria. Your listings live in your own account on the Atmosphere.

GetStarted.title: Get started
GetStarted.intro: Homeward runs on the Atmosphere, the open network behind Bluesky. Your account and your listings belong to you, not to us.
GetStarted.haveAccountHeading: Already on Bluesky or another Atmosphere app?
GetStarted.haveAccountBody: You can use your existing account, wherever it is hosted. Skip to step 2.
GetStarted.step1Heading: 1. Create a free account with Eurosky
GetStarted.step1Body: Eurosky hosts accounts in Europe, under European law. Your handle will look like yourname.eurosky.social. Rescue organisations can later use their own website address as their handle.
GetStarted.step2Body: Sign in to the Bluesky app. If your account is with Eurosky, choose a custom hosting provider and enter {provider}. Then go to Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords, and create one called "Homeward".
GetStarted.step3Body: Use your handle and the app password you just created.
GetStarted.whyBody: An app password lets Homeward publish listings and keep your profile up to date without ever seeing your main password. It can't change your password, email or account settings. You can revoke it at any time in your account settings, and Homeward loses access. Homeward refuses main passwords.

Welcome.title: Welcome to Homeward
Welcome.intro: How will you use Homeward? Choose the one that fits.
Welcome.orgBody: Publish animals in need of a home, with clear adoption criteria. Your profile and listings are public and live in your own account.
Welcome.adopterBody: Find animals that suit your home. Details about your household stay private: Homeward stores them encrypted and never publishes them.

OrganisationProfile.title: Your organisation profile
OrganisationProfile.intro: This is your public profile on Homeward. It's saved to your own account on the Atmosphere, so it stays yours.
OrganisationProfile.loadFailed: We couldn't load your profile from your account. Please try again in a moment.
OrganisationProfile.savedNotFound: Your profile is saved, but we couldn't find {locality} on the map, so your animals won't appear in distance searches yet. Check the spelling, or try a nearby town.
OrganisationProfile.savedUnavailable: Your profile is saved, but we couldn't look up {locality} on the map just now, so your animals won't appear in distance searches yet. Save again later to try once more.
OrganisationProfile.unlocated: Your town isn't on the map yet, so your animals won't appear in distance searches. Check its spelling, then save.
OrganisationProfile.descriptionHint: Who you are, which animals you help and where you work.
OrganisationProfile.donationsHint: Links where people can support you. To remove one, clear its address.
OrganisationProfile.charityHint: If you're on an official charity register, add it here. We show it as declared by you, with a link so adopters can check it themselves.
OrganisationProfile.charityRegistryHint: For example, the Charity Commission for England and Wales.
OrganisationProfile.charityUrl: Link to your entry in the register (optional)
OrganisationProfile.adoptionProcessHint: The steps from first contact to taking an animal home, such as a visit or a home check.

AdopterProfile.title: Your home and preferences
AdopterProfile.intro: Tell us about your home so we can show how well each animal suits you. It takes a few minutes, and you can come back any time.
AdopterProfile.privacyPrivate: Your answers about your household, home and where you live are private. Homeward keeps them encrypted on servers in the EU and uses them only to work out your matches. They're never published, and organisations can't see them unless you choose to share them when you enquire.
AdopterProfile.privacyOptional: Every question is optional. If you'd rather not say, choose “Prefer not to say” and matches show “Not enough information” for that point. We never guess.
AdopterProfile.privacyControl: You can change your answers or delete them at any time.
AdopterProfile.privacyPublic: Separately, you can choose to publish a short public profile to your own account, so organisations can see what you're looking for. It shows only your region and country, never your town or address.
AdopterProfile.children: Do children live with you or visit often?
AdopterProfile.youngestAgeHint: Only if you answered yes. Some animals need older children.
AdopterProfile.otherAnimals: Do you have other animals at home?
AdopterProfile.experience: Have you looked after an animal like this before?
AdopterProfile.homeType: What kind of home do you live in?
AdopterProfile.gardenSecureHint: Only if you have a garden.
AdopterProfile.settingUrban: In a town or city centre
AdopterProfile.stepFree: Can you get into and around your home without stairs?
AdopterProfile.tenure: Do you own or rent your home?
AdopterProfile.hoursAlone: On a typical day, how long would an animal be left alone?
AdopterProfile.willingMedicalCare: Could you look after an animal with ongoing medical needs?
AdopterProfile.willingSpecialDiet: Could you look after an animal on a special diet?
AdopterProfile.willingBehaviouralSupport: Could you help an animal that needs behavioural support or training?
AdopterProfile.acceptsHomeVisit: Would you welcome a home visit before adopting?
AdopterProfile.canVisitSeveralTimes: Could you visit the animal several times before adopting?
AdopterProfile.locationHint: For example, Utrecht or SW1A. We round it to about 1 km and use it only for your own distance searches. Never your full address.
AdopterProfile.placeChooseHint: Choose yours so we can work out distances.
AdopterProfile.publish: Publish a public profile to my account
AdopterProfile.publishHint: Organisations can see what you are looking for. Untick this to remove it from your account.
AdopterProfile.publicArea: Your profile shows your area as: {area}.
AdopterProfile.publicAreaNone: Your profile won't show an area until you add where you live.
AdopterProfile.aboutHint: A few words for organisations, such as your routine or what you can offer. Up to 1,000 characters.

AdopterProfile.savedUnavailable: Your answers are saved, but we couldn't look up {place} just now, so your location hasn't changed. Please try again later.
AdopterProfile.publishFailed: Your private answers are saved, but we couldn't update the public profile in your account. Please try again in a moment.
AdopterProfile.invalidSummary: Some answers need checking. They're marked below.
AdopterProfile.publicLoadFailed: We couldn't check your public profile in your account just now. Saving won't change it unless you tick “Publish”.
